_about: Demosthenes in English, translator per title. Charles Rann Kennedy (Bohn, 1852-63, 5 vols.): vols. 1-4 as raw IA OCR from mixed printings (1855, 1880, 1856, 1877); his Olynthiacs and Philippics clean on Gutenberg. A. W. Pickard-Cambridge, The Public Orations (Oxford, 1912), 2 vols., clean Gutenberg (US PD by date; Pickard-Cambridge d. 1952).
